The structure of Li2Mn2Mg4Cu4O16 (reduced formula LiMn(MgCu)2O8) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with four O neighbors, Li and Mn each coordinated by six O, and Mg centers with eight O neighbors. O centers are two-coordinate, linking Cu and Mg or Cu and Li/Mn. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Mn, Mg and Li, and Cu-centered four-vertex polyhedra.
